neighbours.mechanism_note: Similar symptoms, different cause. leukodystrophy, hypomyelinating, 18: primary hypomyelination (myelin is never properly formed; PLP1 / PMD spectrum, POLR3) (via MONDO:0032730 MONDO label 'leukodystrophy, hypomyelinating, 18'). Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome 5: type 1 interferonopathy (innate immune activation) (via MONDO:0700264 type 1 interferonopathy). No shared causal gene; phenotype similarity simGIC 0.17. Assets and trial designs do not transfer between them without expert review. Reactome: no shared specific pathway between the causal genes.

papers_mentioning.title: Sphingolipid desaturase DEGS1 is essential for mitochondria-associated membrane integrity.
The atypical sphingolipid SPB 18:1(14Z);O2 is a biomarker for DEGS1 related hypomyelinating leukodystrophy.
Loss of dihydroceramide desaturase drives neurodegeneration by disrupting endoplasmic reticulum and lipid droplet homeostasis in glial cells.
Deletion Testing of the DEGS1 Gene Should Be Part of the Diagnostic Pipeline for Hypomyelinating Leukodystrophy (HLD18).
A novel splice site variant in DEGS1 leads to aberrant splicing and loss of DEGS1 enzyme activity, a VUS resolved.
